findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "metiers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the ten trade families used by Kranli (heating and heat pumps, solar, windows, roofing, facades, interior, outdoor and pools, new build, civil engineering, electrical) with their identifiers and recent counts. / Les dix familles de métiers de Kranli, avec leurs identifiants et leurs demandes ré" → after: "List the eleven trade families used by Kranli (heating and heat pumps, solar, windows, roofing, facades, interior, outdoor and pools, new build, civil engineering, electrical, balconies and lifts) with their identifiers and recent counts. / Les onze familles de métiers de Kranli, avec leurs identifi"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
